tagline: Generate embeddable forms and grids to drop into any existing website
verdictSummary: Caspio's actual mechanic — build a form, report, or grid against your database, then get an embed snippet to drop into any existing website — is a real weekend build once you separate 'the embeddable widget' from 'the app.' What doesn't survive: Caspio's compliance certifications (HIPAA, SOC 2) that make it a defensible choice for regulated industries, which a personal project can't credibly claim.
coreLoopDIY: Define a table and a form or grid view against it, and generate a small embeddable JavaScript snippet that renders that view inside an iframe on any external website, reading and writing to your own database via a scoped API token.
whatYouLose: compliance certifications defensible for regulated industries
a large library of pre-built view templates
whyPeopleStillPay: The embed mechanic is buildable; being the vendor a healthcare or government client's compliance team will actually sign off on is a business relationship and certification process, not a coding problem.
prompt: Build a tool that generates embeddable forms and grids you can drop into any existing website — Caspio's actual core mechanic, distinct from an all-in-one app builder. Use Next.js/TypeScript with Postgres. Let the user define a table (typed fields) and build a form view or a read-only grid view against it. For each view, generate an embed snippet: an iframe pointing at a hosted, scoped page for that view, authenticated by a per-view API token, not a full user login, so it can be embedded on a completely separate website without requiring visitors to have an account. Handle form submissions server-side, writing validated data back to the table. Support basic styling options, a few color and font choices, so the embedded iframe can loosely match the host site rather than looking obviously foreign. Do not build compliance certifications, a large template library, or granular field-level permissions beyond a table-level API token — those are out of scope; this is the embeddable-view mechanic, not the certified enterprise product. Requires hosting and a database; no external API key needed for the core build.

faq.q: Can I embed a form on a website that isn't hosted by this tool?
faq.a: Yes — that's the actual point. The embed snippet is a self-contained iframe pointing back at your hosted instance, so it works on any external site, no different login required for visitors.

No — compliance certification is a business and audit process, not something a personal build can credibly claim. If you handle regulated data, that's a real reason to keep paying for a certified vendor.

faq.q: How many pre-built view templates does it include?
faq.a: None — you build each form or grid from scratch. Caspio's larger template library is real accumulated product content this build doesn't include.

faq.q: What does it cost to run?
faq.a: Hosting and a database — typically a few dollars a month, with no per-embed fee.
